description: Trigger discrimination for the design conductor (this skill) vs the project journey front door (project-orchestrator), bounded UX design iteration (ux-design-iteration), the non-happy-state matrix designer (edge-state-ux-designer), the technical design-doc review facilitator (design-review-facilitator), design-token governance (design-system-token-governor), the QA conductor (qa-orchestrator) and security scanning (security-scan-orchestrator).

cases.prompt: I do not know where to start with the UI. Help me design my app's screens end to end and tell me what to hand to the build.
cases.note: PRIMARY — the user wants the design work chosen and sequenced across a whole pass, not the product journey and not one named design skill.
cases.reason: Sequencing the design work across the fixed plays is the conductor; the named neighbours own the journey and individual design steps.

cases.prompt: I want to build and ship a product from my idea — what do I do first?
cases.note: JOURNEY-vs-DESIGN SEAM — no design goal is stated; the request is the whole lifecycle.
cases.reason: The beginner journey across stages is project-orchestrator; the design conductor starts only after the guide's steps 1-3 are met.

cases.prompt: Offer me the up-front choice between the standard design journey and explore-and-refine, and record my choice.
cases.note: ITERATION-vs-PASS SEAM — one bounded iteration method and its offer/record, not a whole pass.
cases.reason: The optional bounded iteration method, including its one up-front offer and record, is ux-design-iteration; the conductor never offers or re-offers it.

cases.prompt: Design the empty, loading, error and permission-denied state matrix for this one view.
cases.note: SINGLE DESIGN STEP — the user names the state matrix they want.
cases.reason: Per-view non-happy-state design is edge-state-ux-designer; it is play A/B/C only when the user needs the whole pass chosen and sequenced.

cases.prompt: Review this design doc before our decision meeting: problem, proposal, alternatives and cross-cutting concerns are in it.
cases.note: TECHNICAL-DESIGN-DOC REVIEW — a specific reviewable proposal, not a design pass.
cases.reason: Facilitating a technical design-doc review is design-review-facilitator; the conductor only marks it conditional when a reviewable technical design proposal exists inside a play.

cases.prompt: Govern our design tokens: build the semantic taxonomy and migration rules for this existing design system.
cases.note: TOKEN GOVERNANCE — one named design-system capability.
cases.reason: Token taxonomy, naming and migration governance is design-system-token-governor; it is one routed step, not the conductor.

cases.prompt: Help me test my app end to end and find the bugs.
cases.note: QA-vs-DESIGN SEAM — the goal is testing the running app, not designing its UI.
cases.reason: A whole QA pass is qa-orchestrator; the design conductor never drives the app or executes tests.

cases.prompt: Run a whole-repo security scan and aggregate the SAST, dependency and secret findings.
cases.reason: Whole-repo static security scanning/aggregation is security-scan-orchestrator; the design conductor designs UI only.
